Track emissions for one pipeline step

carbon_step.Rd

Wraps a single function call `.f(.data, ...)` with `tracker$start()` and `tracker$stop()`, then reads the latest row from CodeCarbon's emissions CSV.

Usage

carbon_step(
  .data,
  .f,
  ...,
  tracker,
  label = NULL,
  task_id = uuid::UUIDgenerate(),
  output_dir = NULL,
  output_file = "emissions.csv"
)

Arguments

.data

Input data (pipe LHS).

.f

Function to apply to `.data` (must accept `.data` as first arg).

...

Passed to `.f`.

tracker

A CodeCarbon tracker from `carbon_init_pipe()`.

label

Optional human-readable label for the step.

task_id

Optional UUID string for joining/identification.

output_dir

Directory containing the emissions CSV. If NULL, attempts to read from `tracker$output_dir`.

output_file

CSV filename (default "emissions.csv").

Value

The transformed object (result of `.f(.data, ...)`) with a `carbon_log` attribute (tibble).

Details

This is robust across CodeCarbon versions where `tracker$stop()` returns only a numeric (kgCO2) rather than a full data object.
